title: AeroManip-VLA: Scalable Vision-Language-Action Learning for Aerial Manipulation with RL-Generated Demonstrations
abstract: arXiv:2609.36915v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Aerial manipulators extend robotic manipulation into 3D workspaces that are difficult for ground-based robots to access, creating new opportunities for general-purpose manipulation. However, extending Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to aerial robots introduces distinct challenges due to the tight coupling between manipulation and flight, continuously changing observations, and safety-critical physical interactions. These challenges demand diverse training data and systematic policy evaluation, yet collecting demonstrations and evaluating policies directly on physical aerial platforms are costly, difficult to scale, and hard to repeat under controlled conditions. We present AeroManip-VLA, a scalable benchmark for aerial VLA data generation and policy evaluation. translated_title: AeroManip-VLA：基于强化学习生成演示的空中操作可扩展视觉-语言-动作学习
translated_abstract: 空中操作臂将机器人操作扩展到了地面机器人难以进入的三维工作空间，为通用操作创造了新的机会。然而，将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型扩展到空中机器人面临着独特的挑战：操作与飞行之间紧密耦合、观测持续变化、以及涉及安全攸关的物理交互。这些挑战需要多样化的训练数据和系统化的策略评估，然而直接在物理空中平台上收集演示和评估策略成本高昂、难以规模化，且难以在受控条件下重复进行。我们提出了AeroManip-VLA，一个用于空中VLA数据生成与策略评估的可扩展基准。AeroManip-VLA提供了一个GPU加速的仿真框架，能够在大规模并行环境中实现低层的载荷感知飞行与操作控制。基于……
tldr: 提出AeroManip-VLA，一个可扩展的空中操作VLA基准，通过GPU加速仿真框架和强化学习生成的演示数据，实现空中VLA数据生成与策略评估。
en_tdlr: AeroManip-VLA is a scalable benchmark for aerial manipulation that enables VLA data generation and policy evaluation through a GPU-accelerated simulation framework with RL-generated demonstrations.
